name: Slasher
description: Prerequisite: Level 4+ You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Hamstring.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Slashing damage, you can reduce the Speed of that creature by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Enhanced Critical.description: When you score a Critical Hit that deals Slashing damage to a creature, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
